BiblicalUsage: Manasseh's lot includes Beth-shean and Ibleam and Dor and Endor and Taanach and Megiddo, even three heights among the towns of Issachar and Asher.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the heights are the strong places: the towns on the high ground are worth naming, and Manasseh's lot is measured town by town and height by height.
